title: The Ladder
summary: Weeks seven and eight. A board game night with total strangers: the Critic at its loudest, the courage ladder, opening lines, and the first look behind the curtain at what others really thought. Ends with 9 lights.

interaction.prompt: Before you go: how awkward do you think it'll be?

interaction.title: The ladder
interaction.text: At your place (or a new one), climb one rung higher than last time. Before you go, rate how awkward you think it'll be. After, rate how it really was.
